name: Visual & Interactive Narratives
description: This course explores the principles and practices of visual storytelling and interactive narrative design. Students will engage with theories of narrative design, new media technologies and interactivity while creating digital projects. The course emphasizes creativity, critical analysis, and hands-on production to develop engaging narrative-driven through various media like augmented reality, virtual reality, games, animations, and various forms of new media visualizations.
